snippet.title: Amiga Longplay: War Zone (Paradox)
snippet.description:
This is so bad in all ways! It is stupid hard, there are only one level, it runs in 10 fps and the game is flickering. I also got hit a few times but did not die (nope, did not use trainer/cheat).

There exists another game with the same title (developed by Core). That game is much better. But there already are longplays of that. This one however, has not been "longplayed" yet.
